class.name: NNBTRepeatUntil
class.brief_description: Ticks its child until the child returns the [member expected_tick_result], or until [member max_repeat_times] ticks are exhausted.
class.description: The RepeatUntil node ticks its child until the [member expected_tick_result] is returned by its child, or until [member max_repeat_times] ticks are exhausted. If [member max_repeat_times] is set to [code]-1[/code], only the [member expected_tick_result] will end the loop. Reaching [member expected_tick_result] completes the node with [code]SUCCESS[/code] and exhausting [member max_repeat_times] without a match completes it with [code]FAILURE[/code]. The completed result stays stable until the node is reset according to [member reset_rule].

members.member: The result that the child node should return to end the loop. Can be either [code]-1[/code]=[code]FAILURE[/code], [code]0[/code]=[code]RUNNING[/code] or [code]1[/code]=[code]SUCCESS[/code]. When it is returned the node completes with [code]SUCCESS[/code].

The maximum number of times the child node can be ticked. Exhausting the budget without getting [member expected_tick_result] completes the node with [code]FAILURE[/code]. Set to [code]-1[/code] to repeat without a budget.
